text.title: FreshDrop: weekly orders and profit, Q3 2026
text.nsm: Weekly orders per active buyer = orders ÷ buyers; now 1.8
text.pulse1: Weekly open rate 64%; slot picked in 58% of orders
text.pulse2: Cart abandon rate 28%; substitutions accepted in 71% of orders
text.traction: Week-4 retention, basket size and delivery time drive weekly orders most
text.decision: Bet on basket size: test «buy 3, get 1 free». Check weekly orders every Monday
